## cc-calendar-facade — the Central Command entry point
Mirrors `cc-email-facade` exactly: POST webhook → hardcoded token check on header `x-cc-token` → call the credential-holding lib. **No credentials live on this canvas.**

### ✅ NO MANUAL STEPS — wired and active
- Token is set in **Auth + unwrap** and matches `CC_CALENDAR_FACADE_TOKEN` in the repo-root `.env`.
- **Call lib-google-calendar** is bound by id to `lib-google-calendar` (`GSyOmRlOCoyc9Nrh`).

URL: `http://localhost:5678/webhook/cc-calendar-facade`

this façade serves list (ungated read) plus create_event / update_event / delete_event, which the Central Command Executor calls ONLY after the operator approved the proposal that named them. Nothing agent-side can reach this webhook.
